text.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قٓ ۚ وَٱلْقُرْءَانِ ٱلْمَجِيدِ

translations.asad: Qaf. CONSIDER this sublime Qur’an!
translations.sahih: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an...

text.arabic: بَلْ عَجِبُوٓا۟ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرٌۭ مِّنْهُمْ فَقَالَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَىْءٌ عَجِيبٌ

translations.asad: But nay - they deem it strange that a warner should have come unto them from their own midst; and so these deniers of the truth are saying, “A strange thing is this!
translations.sahih: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing.

text.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتْنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابًۭا ۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجْعٌۢ بَعِيدٌۭ

translations.asad: Why - [how could we be resurrected] after we have died and become mere dust? Such a return seems far-fetched indeed!”
translations.sahih: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return."

text.arabic: قَدْ عَلِمْنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلْأَرْضُ مِنْهُمْ ۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظٌۢ

translations.asad: Well do We know how the earth consumes their bodies, for with Us is a record unfailing.
translations.sahih: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record.

text.arabic: بَلْ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمْ فَهُمْ فِىٓ أَمْرٍۢ مَّرِيجٍ

translations.asad: Nay, but they [who refuse to believe in resurrection] have been wont to give the lie to this truth whenever it was proffered to them; and so they are in a state of confusion.
translations.sahih: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.

text.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَنظُرُوٓا۟ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوْقَهُمْ كَيْفَ بَنَيْنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجٍۢ

translations.asad: Do they not look at the sky above them - how We have built it and made it beautiful and free of all faults?
translations.sahih: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?

text.arabic: وَٱلْأَرْضَ مَدَدْنَٰهَا وَأَلْقَيْنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِىَ وَأَنۢبَتْنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوْجٍۭ بَهِيجٍۢ

translations.asad: And the earth - We have spread it wide, and set upon it mountains firm, and caused it to bring forth plants of all beauteous kinds,
translations.sahih: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,

text.arabic: تَبْصِرَةًۭ وَذِكْرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبْدٍۢ مُّنِيبٍۢ

translations.asad: thus offering an insight and a reminder unto every human being who willingly turns unto God.
translations.sahih: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah].

text.arabic: وَنَزَّلْنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ مُّبَٰرَكًۭا فَأَنۢبَتْنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتٍۢ وَحَبَّ ٱلْحَصِيدِ

translations.asad: And We send down from the skies water rich in blessings, and cause thereby gardens to grow, and fields of grain,
translations.sahih: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

text.arabic: وَٱلنَّخْلَ بَاسِقَٰتٍۢ لَّهَا طَلْعٌۭ نَّضِيدٌۭ

translations.asad: and tall palm-trees with their thickly-clustered dates,
translations.sahih: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers -

text.arabic: رِّزْقًۭا لِّلْعِبَادِ ۖ وَأَحْيَيْنَا بِهِۦ بَلْدَةًۭ مَّيْتًۭا ۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْخُرُوجُ

translations.asad: as sustenance appor­tioned to men; and by [all] this We bring dead land to life: [and] even so will be [man’s] coming-forth from death.
translations.sahih: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection.

text.arabic: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍۢ وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ

translations.asad: [Long] before those [who now deny resur­rection] did Noah’s people give the lie to this truth, and [so did] the folk of Ar-Rass, and [the tribes of] Thamud
translations.sahih: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud

text.arabic: وَعَادٌۭ وَفِرْعَوْنُ وَإِخْوَٰنُ لُوطٍۢ

translations.asad: and Ad, and Pharaoh, and Lot’s brethren,
translations.sahih: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot

text.arabic: وَأَصْحَٰبُ ٱلْأَيْكَةِ وَقَوْمُ تُبَّعٍۢ ۚ كُلٌّۭ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ

translations.asad: and the dwellers of the wooded dales [of Madyan], and the people of Tubba: they all gave the lie to the apostles - and thereupon that whereof I had warned [them] came true.
translations.sahih: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.

text.arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلْخَلْقِ ٱلْأَوَّلِ ۚ بَلْ هُمْ فِى لَبْسٍۢ مِّنْ خَلْقٍۢ جَدِيدٍۢ

translations.asad: Could We, then, be [thought of as being] worn out by the first creation? Nay - but some people are [still] lost in doubt about [the possibility of] a new creation!
translations.sahih: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعْلَمُ مَا تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفْسُهُۥ ۖ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ ٱلْوَرِيدِ

translations.asad: NOW, VERILY, it is We who have created man, and We know what his innermost self whispers within him: for We are closer to him than his neck-vein.
translations.sahih: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein

text.arabic: إِذْ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلْمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلْيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدٌۭ

translations.asad: [And so,] whenever the two demands [of his nature] come face to face, contending from the right and from the left,
translations.sahih: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left.

text.arabic: مَّا يَلْفِظُ مِن قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌۭ

translations.asad: not even a word can he utter but there is a watcher with him, ever-present.
translations.sahih: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].

text.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ سَكْرَةُ ٱلْمَوْتِ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنْهُ تَحِيدُ

translations.asad: And [then,] the twilight of death brings with it the [full] truth that [very thing, O man,] from which thou wouldst always look away! –
translations.sahih: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.

text.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْوَعِيدِ

translations.asad: and [in the end] the trumpet [of resurrection] will be blown: that will be the Day of a warning fulfilled.
translations.sahih: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.

text.arabic: وَجَآءَتْ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۢ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقٌۭ وَشَهِيدٌۭ

translations.asad: And every human being will come forward with [his erstwhile] inner urges and [his] conscious mind,
translations.sahih: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.

text.arabic: لَّقَدْ كُنتَ فِى غَفْلَةٍۢ مِّنْ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفْنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ حَدِيدٌۭ

translations.asad: [and will be told:] “Indeed, unmindful hast thou been of this [Day of Judgment]; but now We have lifted from thee thy veil, and sharp is thy sight today!”
translations.sahih: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp."

text.arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَىَّ عَتِيدٌ

translations.asad: And one part of him will say: “This it is that has been ever-present with me!”
translations.sahih: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared."

text.arabic: أَلْقِيَا فِى جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدٍۢ

translations.asad: [Whereupon God will command:] “Cast, cast into hell every [such] stubborn enemy of the truth,
translations.sahih: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,

text.arabic: مَّنَّاعٍۢ لِّلْخَيْرِ مُعْتَدٍۢ مُّرِيبٍ

translations.asad: [every] withholder of good [and] sinful aggressor [and] fomentor of distrust [between man and man – everyone]
translations.sahih: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,

text.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلْقِيَاهُ فِى ٱلْعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ

translations.asad: who has set up another deity beside God: cast him, then, cast him into suffering severe!”
translations.sahih: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment."

text.arabic: ۞ قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطْغَيْتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِى ضَلَٰلٍۭ بَعِيدٍۢ

translations.asad: Man’s other self’ will say: “O our Sustainer! It was not I that led his conscious mind into evil [nay,] but it had gone far astray [of its own accord]!
translations.sahih: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error."

text.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخْتَصِمُوا۟ لَدَىَّ وَقَدْ قَدَّمْتُ إِلَيْكُم بِٱلْوَعِيدِ

translations.asad: [And] He will say: “Contend not before Me, [O you sinners,] for I gave you a forewarning [of this Day of Reckoning].
translations.sahih: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning.

text.arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلْقَوْلُ لَدَىَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمٍۢ لِّلْعَبِيدِ

translations.asad: The judgment passed by Me shall not be altered; but never do I do the least wrong unto My creatures!”
translations.sahih: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants."

text.arabic: يَوْمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمْتَلَأْتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلْ مِن مَّزِيدٍۢ

translations.asad: On that Day We will ask hell, “Art thou filled?”- and it will answer, “[Nay,] is there yet more [for me]?”
translations.sahih: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more,"

text.arabic: وَأُزْلِفَتِ ٱلْجَنَّةُ لِلْمُتَّقِينَ غَيْرَ بَعِيدٍ

translations.asad: And [on that Day] paradise will be brought within the sight of the God-conscious, and will no longer be far away; [and they will be told:]
translations.sahih: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,

text.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظٍۢ

translations.asad: “This is what you were promised - [promised] unto every­one who was wont to turn unto God and to keep Him always in mind –
translations.sahih: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]

text.arabic: مَّنْ خَشِىَ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنَ بِٱلْغَيْبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلْبٍۢ مُّنِيبٍ

translations.asad: [everyone] who stood in awe of the Most Gracious although He is beyond the reach of human perception, and who has come [unto Him] with a heart full of contrition.
translations.sahih: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].

text.arabic: ٱدْخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمٍۢ ۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُلُودِ

translations.asad: Enter this [paradise] in peace; this is the Day on which life abiding begins!”
translations.sahih: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity."

text.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيْنَا مَزِيدٌۭ

translations.asad: In that [paradise] they shall have whatever they may desire - but there is yet more with Us.
translations.sahih: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.

text.arabic: وَكَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّن قَرْنٍ هُمْ أَشَدُّ مِنْهُم بَطْشًۭا فَنَقَّبُوا۟ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ هَلْ مِن مَّحِيصٍ

translations.asad: AND HOW MANY a generation have We destroyed before those [who now deny the truth] people of greater might than theirs; but [when Our chastise­ment befell them,] they became wanderers on the face of the earth, seeking no more than a place of refuge
translations.sahih: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?

text.arabic: إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكْرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلْبٌ أَوْ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّمْعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدٌۭ

translations.asad: In this, behold, there is indeed a reminder for everyone whose heart is wide-awake -that is, [every­one who] lends ear with a conscious mind -
translations.sahih: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].

text.arabic: وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضَ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا فِى سِتَّةِ أَيَّامٍۢ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبٍۢ

translations.asad: and [who knows that] We have indeed created the heavens and the earth and all that is between them in six aeons, and [that] no weariness could ever touch Us.
translations.sahih: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.

text.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ ٱلْغُرُوبِ

translations.asad: HENCE, [O believer,] bear thou with patience what­ever they may say, and extol thy Sustainer’s limit­less glory and praise before the rising of the sun and before its setting;
translations.sahih: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,

text.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْهُ وَأَدْبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ

translations.asad: and in the night, too, extol His glory, and at every prayer’s end.
translations.sahih: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration.

text.arabic: وَٱسْتَمِعْ يَوْمَ يُنَادِ ٱلْمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانٍۢ قَرِيبٍۢ

translations.asad: And [always] listen for the day when He who issues the call [of death] shall call [thee] from close-by;
translations.sahih: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -

text.arabic: يَوْمَ يَسْمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيْحَةَ بِٱلْحَقِّ ۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوْمُ ٱلْخُرُوجِ

translations.asad: [and bethink thyself, too, of] the Day on which all [human beings] will in truth hear the final blast - that Day of [their] coming-forth [from death].
translations.sahih: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].

text.arabic: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نُحْىِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيْنَا ٱلْمَصِيرُ

translations.asad: Verily, it is We who grant life and deal death; and with Us will be all journeys’ end
translations.sahih: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

text.arabic: يَوْمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلْأَرْضُ عَنْهُمْ سِرَاعًۭا ۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشْرٌ عَلَيْنَا يَسِيرٌۭ

translations.asad: on the Day when the earth is riven asunder all around them as they hasten forth [towards God’s judgment]: that gathering will be easy for Us [to encompass].
translations.sahih: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.

text.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ ۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيْهِم بِجَبَّارٍۢ ۖ فَذَكِّرْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ

translations.asad: Fully aware are We of what they [who deny resurrection] do say; and thou canst by no means force them [to believe in it]. Yet none the less, remind, through this Qur’an, all such as may fear My warning.
translations.sahih: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat.
